assumptions: Offline snapshots and SHA256: references/models/source-lock.json. BF16 mathematical/materialized causal GQA reference; no measured kernel or GPU performance claim. Weight tying follows config, despite duplicate serialized lm_head. HBM assumption: one declared read/write per buffer; no cache/reuse/materialized repeat_kv guarantee. Vector counts approximate norms 5/element, QK norm + RoPE 8/element, softmax 5/score, SiLU×up 6/element. FP32 vector work is separated from BF16 matrix work. No fused attention, rotary table/trig construction, allocator/runtime overhead or network model.
